name: stylos-design-system
description: Stylos Design System — documentation, canonical design tokens, and Figma Agent skill sources.

scripts.build:publish: npm run workshop:build && npm run build
scripts.ui:generate: node tools/build-css.mjs && node tools/build-ui-icons.mjs && node tools/build-ui-types.mjs && node tools/build-ui-stories.mjs && node tools/build-ui-css.mjs && node tools/build-ui-fonts.mjs && node tools/build-text-css.mjs
scripts.ui:check: npm run ui:generate && npm run check -w @stylos/ui
scripts.workshop: npm run ui:generate && npm run dev -w stylos-workshop
scripts.workshop:build: npm run ui:generate && npm run build -w stylos-workshop
